params.message:
A report's source list is made in Gentells before the PDF is

The Studio can check pasted sources against Gentells, hold the ones that
stand under the report, search what Gentells already holds, take a source
off, and give the numbered list out as text with each source's address on
gentells.com.

Portal: Report writers can now turn their sources into Gentells sources in the Studio and copy the finished source list for the design.
